name: odibee_sans
description: Odibee Sans is a display font project by London-based designer James Barnard. James set out to create his very own one day build (ODB) and completed the entire character set, numbers and the basic glyphs in 24 hours. To contribute, see github.com/barnard555/odibeesans .
